status: candidate: design of the four shop houses of the central town
reference: a game-scale concept screen of the central town (knight, houses, stall and rug), and the knight sheet
scale: not drawn beside the knight; for the concept each house was shrunk by 0.618 so the buildings are 3.4 units wide
prompt:
Image 1 is a screen of the central town of a top-down 2D pixel-art fantasy action game, with the player's knight standing in the square. Image 2 shows the knight large. Draw four shop buildings for this town, in exactly the art style of the houses, the knight and the props of Image 1.

Layout: exactly 1 row and 4 columns on a completely flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Each building is centred in an evenly spaced column, stands on the same ground line, and keeps clear magenta space around it. All four buildings have the same size and the same basic shape as the small timber-framed houses with red tiled roofs in Image 1: two storeys, a front wall facing the viewer and a tiled roof. Each is about as wide as it is tall.

Every shop has a wide open window with a wooden counter in the middle of its front wall, and a shopkeeper with the same chibi proportions as the knight leans on the counter, facing the viewer. Each shop is easy to tell apart from far away by its colours, its hanging sign (a picture only) and the goods displayed outside:

Column 1, weapon shop: a dark grey slate roof, a hanging sign with a picture of a crossed sword and axe, a weapon rack with swords and spears beside the counter, and a small anvil. The shopkeeper is a burly blacksmith with a leather apron.
Column 2, armour shop: a deep blue roof, a hanging sign with a picture of a shield, a wooden stand wearing a steel helmet and breastplate beside the counter, and a round shield leaning on the wall. The shopkeeper is a stout armourer.
Column 3, magic shop: a purple roof with a small pointed turret, a hanging sign with a picture of a crystal ball and a star, glowing crystals and a few potion bottles in the window, and a small floating light. The shopkeeper is a witch with a pointed hat.
Column 4, item shop: a green roof, a hanging sign with a picture of a potion bottle, crates and barrels of goods, sacks and bundles of herbs beside the counter. The shopkeeper is a friendly woman with a headscarf.

Style rules, taken from Image 1 and the knight: a continuous near-black outline one dot thick around every silhouette, flat cel shading with 3 or 4 clean tones and a small highlight, light from the upper left, clean chunky clusters of dots, no noise or dithering, saturated colours, bold simple readable shapes, the same slightly-from-above three-quarter front view.

Do not include: text, letters, numbers, ground, grass, paving, shadows on the background, borders, grid lines, or any other object. Everything outside the four buildings stays completely flat solid pure magenta, RGB 255,0,255.
